( #{item.transactionAt}, #{item.description}, #{item.transactionType}, #{item.transactionInstitution}, #{item.accountNumber}, #{item.amount}, #{item.balanceAfter}, #{item.memo}, #{item.sourceFileName}, #{item.sourceRowNumber}, #{item.categoryId}, #{item.cashflowType}, #{item.isFixed}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.paymentMethod}, #{item.externalKey}, #{item.recurrenceType}, #{item.memoOwner}, #{item.memoTargetYearMonth}, #{item.memoParseStatus}, #{item.classificationStatus}, #{item.fixedStatus} )

( NULL, #{item.cashflowType}, #{item.name}, 1, #{item.sortOrder}, 1 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_active = VALUES(is_active), sort_order = LEAST(sort_order, VALUES(sort_order)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
